info.title: Nu local API
info.description: Loopback-only JSON API of the Nu daemon. Every error is {"error": {code, message, action?, details?}}; codes are stable and map to CLI exit categories (see api/apiv0). List endpoints page with opaque cursors and answer resync:true when a cursor expired. Long-running work is an operation with an ID, exact target, stage, progress, NDJSON event stream and wait. Requests must carry a loopback Host with this listener's port; state-changing requests with a foreign Origin or a cross-site Sec-Fetch-Site are rejected; no CORS headers are ever sent.

get.summary: A local-cluster dataset

Collection status on this node: merged catalog root and writer heads, items, facet gaps, conflicts, local holdings and shortfall, holdings-log position, and the holdings index summary when this node runs it

Items: with since ("0" or a next_cursor) the item change stream in seq order, each changed path once with its latest state (next_cursor always set; resync when the cursor's epoch is gone); otherwise current items filtered by prefix, holder, held, unheld or a match rule, optionally rarest first (copy counts need the holdings index)

Fetch at://<handle-or-did>/<collection>/<rkey> from the account's PDS with its proof (commit signature against the DID document key, MST inclusion) and return the verified record as atproto-style JSON with its commit CID and rev. The proof blocks are kept in the store.

post.summary: Start a snapshot operation (result: AtSnapshot): getRepo for at://<handle-or-did>, verified completely (signature, MST, records), stored and pinned under the atrepo profile; with blobs, referenced blobs ≤ 8 MiB too (atrepo+blobs). Browse the result with /ls and /cat on at:// targets and on the gateway's /at/ routes.

Start a CAR import operation (result: CarImport): read a DASL CAR from an absolute local path, verify it under a walk profile (nu-tree, atrepo, drisl; detected from the root when omitted) and pin it. atrepo imports verify the signature with the given key or the online-resolved DID document; offline imports verify structure only and say so.

get.summary: Export a held root as a CAR under a walk profile: atrepo in streamable order (commit, MST pre-order with records interleaved), nu-tree and drisl in pre-order; every block once. The root must be complete under the profile.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: walk profile (detected from the root when omitted)

delete.summary: Remove the public mark; the listener stops serving the root.
